tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lha brgyad zhal gtso 'khor lnga tse'u dmar mched bdun bcas la bstod bskul las bzhi'i dmigs pa mdor bsdus// na mo gu ru shrī ma hā kā la ye/ 'og min bdag po rtsod dus ngan spyod la/ /skyengs te srin po'i gzugs kyi gri gug gis/ /bstan dgra'i srog rtsa bcad kyang ma tshim par/ /ro gdan la bzhugs dpal ldan nag po che/ /gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo yum chen dang / /phrin las glog ltar myur ba'i 'dod khams ma/ /mthu ldan zhing skyong dbang phyug yum bzhir bcas/ /gnod sbyin yab yum gnod byed dgra bgegs 'dul/ /dam can pu tras dam nyams srog dbugs len/ /bdud chen bha ṭas bdud dpung phye mar 'thag /sring mo ral gcig khams gsum zil gyis gnon/ /sde bzhi'i 'khor tshogs lha srin sde brgyad bcas/ /khyad par che btsan rol pa skya bdun dang / /dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin bstan bsrungs bas/ /mthu rtsal rmad byung ldan kun bstod par bgyi/ /dkyil 'khor gtso bo rje btsun bla ma yi/ /bka' bzhin rnal 'byor bdag gis bcol ba'i las/ /ma thogs da lta sgrub pa'i dus la babs/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyis/ /thog med nas bsags bcas rang nyes ltung dang / /dam tshig nyams chag nad gdon sdig sgrib tshogs/ /pha rol rbad 'dre rbod gtong la sogs pa'i/ /mi mthun phyogs kun zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /lung rtogs yon tan tshe bsod dpal 'byor dang / /dbang phyug snyan grags stobs dang mthu rtsal dang / /rigs rgyud 'khor dang longs spyod la sogs pa'i/ /legs tshogs yon tan rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /mkhas btsun bzang gsum 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal dang / /rgyal phran khams gsum lha 'dre mi gsum gyi/ /phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan ma lus kun/ /thams cad dbang du 'du bar mdzad du gsol/ /bla ma la sdang thub pa'i bstan la gnod/ /sems can la 'tshe bdag la brnyas byed pa'i/

/zhing bcu tshang ba'i sdig can ji snyed kun/ /lo zla ma 'gyangs tshar gcod mdzad du gsol/ /mdor na deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar/ /lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs nas bsam don kun/ /yid bzhin 'grub nas bdag gzhan ma gyur rnams/ /myur du rdo rje 'chang dbang mngon 'gyur shog/ //ces pa'i bstod bskul gyi tshig dang bcas/ las bzhi'i dmigs pa ni zhi ba'i skabs su mdun bskyed kyi lha tshogs rnams nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros pas nad gdon sdig sgrib 'gal rkyen spyi bye brag byang zhing dag par bsam pa dang / rgyas pa'i tshe de dag gi thugs rjes nam mkha'i khams nas nor bu rin po che la sogs pa'i char 'bab te gnas khang lung pa yul phyogs gang zhing spyi bye drag gi 'dod don rgyas par bsam/ dbang gi tshe de rnams las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu zhags sgrog lta bu 'phros nas 'dod cha gang yin bdag gi dbang du gyur par bsam/ drag po'i tshe de dag gi thugs ka nas pho nya las mkhan mtshon cha thogs pa dpag tu med pas dmigs bya la tshar bcad rjes bzung mdzad par bsam mo/ /zhes lha brgyad zhal gtso 'khor lnga tse'u dmar mched bdun bcas la bstod bskul las bzhi'i dmigs pa mdor bsdus sbyar ba 'di'ang me srong rje drung skal bzang mthu stobs kyi gsung tho'i don bzhin sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos rtse gdong bla brang gi yang steng bsam gtan khang bu blo bde yang rtser bris pa'i yi ge pa ni mdzod pa shes rab phun tshogs kyi bgyis pa dge legs 'phel// //maṅga laṃ// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ lha brgyad zhal gtso 'khor lnga tsi'u dmar mched bdun bcas la bstod bskul/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
